game: Diablo II: Resurrected 3.x (Reign of the Warlock, ladder season 15/16)

conventions.quality: normal = white runeword base (normal OR superior, not low-quality/cracked); superior = superior only; any = ignore quality; rolled = magic, rare or crafted
conventions.item_names: exact uniqueitems.json / setitems.json "index" strings (incl. data typos); when present the rule should only fire if the resolved unique/set name matches. If the overlay cannot resolve names, fall back to code+quality and expect false positives on shared bases (rin, amu, jew, cm3, xsk, uar, 7cr, ...).
conventions.needs_stats: true = base/quality/sockets/eth alone cannot decide value; highlight as "check me"
conventions.tiers: S always highlight, A highlight, B optional
conventions.precedence: if several rules match, use the highest tier
conventions.keep: "one" = one copy per item name is worth keeping across inventory, cube and stashes; further copies are give-aways. Absent = every copy counts
conventions.stats: list of {stat, min[, skills][, tab]}, all must hold on the read item stats (identified items; an unidentified drop has none): skill_tab (any tab; tab = a skill tree name such as "Shape Shifting" narrows it), class_skills, single_skill (skills = names, any of them; empty = any), fcr, ias, life, mana, mf, gold_find, all_res (the lowest of the four), fire_res, cold_res, lightning_res, poison_res, elemental_res (the highest of fire, cold, lightning), max_damage (flat, any hand), attack_rating, fhr, frw, poison_damage (tooltip total: rate x length / 256), lightning_max_damage, fire_max_damage. A rule with stats never matches an item without them
conventions.identified: true/false = required; absent = ignore. false matches only unidentified items (no stats read yet); it goes with no stats or item_names
conventions.own: true = a keeper for the player's own use only (needs stats): no ring, coin or trade keep; the stash plan keeps it when the build values its stats
conventions.any_of: [{min_count, stats: [[condition, ...], ...]}]: each group needs at least min_count entries holding; an entry holds when any of its conditions does (min_count 1 = an or). Like stats, never matches an item without read stats
conventions.money: true = a vendor-gold rule (wands, scepters, sorceress orbs and daggers sold for gold): a trade rule the /config page's "money farming" switch turns off; then it marks nothing and keeps nothing

rules.name: High runes Vex-Zod
rules.note: Vex..Zod are the high-rune trade currency (maxroll). Ber/Jah top.

rules.name: Mid runes Lem-Gul
rules.note: Mid-rune currency for smaller trades (maxroll). Ist/Gul/Mal most liquid.

rules.name: Annihilus
rules.label: Anni
rules.note: Dropped by Uber Diablo / DClone. Value depends on roll but always keep.

rules.name: Hellfire Torch
rules.label: Torc
rules.note: Uber Tristram. Class + roll decide price; every one sells.

rules.name: Unique grand charms (Latent Sunders, Gheed's)
rules.note: RotW: Sunders drop as latent (PreCrafted) grand charms; every unique cm3 on the ground is a keeper. Lightning/Cold/Fire Sunders highest. Gheed's alone is A-tier.

rules.name: Harlequin Crest (Shako)
rules.label: Shak
rules.note: Staple caster helm, always liquid.

rules.name: Griffon's Eye
rules.label: Grif
rules.note: Lightning sorc/LS assassin; high value.

rules.name: Stone of Jordan
rules.label: SoJ
rules.note: Secondary currency; DClone trigger.

rules.name: Top unique amulets
rules.note: Mara's (+2 skills, 20-30 res) and Highlord's (Zeal/Fury builds). Shared base "amu" with ~12 other uniques: needs the unique name.

rules.name: Top unique rings
rules.note: BK (+1 skills), Raven Frost (CBF), Wisp Projector. Shared base "rin": needs the unique name.

rules.name: High-value elite uniques
rules.note: Death's Fathom (data index "Fathom"), Death's Web (data index "Deaths's Web"), CoA, Arachnid, Tyrael's, Dracul's, Verdugo's, Nightwing's, Stormshield, Windforce.

rules.name: Ethereal-only uniques
rules.note: Only ethereal copies have real trade value (merc/indestructible).

rules.name: Mid-value uniques
rules.note: War Traveler, Gore Rider, Thundergod's (data typo "Thudergod's"), +2 class uniques (Herald/Arreat/Jalal/Homunculus), Eschuta's (+3 skill rolls matter), Rainbow Facets (perfect rolls only).

rules.name: Useful build uniques (low/medium value)
rules.note: Sell to new-ladder players or keep for builds. Several only sell with sockets/eth/good rolls (Headhunter 3os, Giantskull 2os, Tomb Reaver eth 3os, Sandstorm eth).

rules.name: Reign of the Warlock uniques
rules.note: New Feb 2026 uniques (grimoires, rings, amulet, belt, boots, dagger). No settled price consensus found; highlight so you notice them. "Unique Warlock Helm" is the data placeholder name on Death Mask.

rules.name: Colossal Jewels
rules.label: CJ
rules.note: Unique Colossal Jewels from the Colossal Ancients fight (lvl 75 req). Reward items, rarely seen on the ground.

rules.name: Tal Rasha's Wrappings
rules.label: TalS
rules.note: Armor (Guardianship/Howling Wind) and amulet sell best. Base "amu"/"xsk" shared with other sets/uniques: needs the set name.

rules.name: Immortal King
rules.label: IK
rules.note: Stone Crusher only tradable with 40% CB; whole set popular early ladder.

rules.name: Trang-Oul's Avatar
rules.label: Trng
rules.note: Claws are used outside the set; rest early-ladder demand.

rules.name: Laying of Hands
rules.label: LoH
rules.note: Bramble Mitts; demand from Paladins/Barbs (IAS + dmg vs demons).

rules.name: Other elite set items
rules.note: Low-medium value; Griswold's Redemption needs 4os, Guillaume's / Bul-Kathos used in builds.

rules.name: Uber keys
rules.note: Terror/Hate/Destruction; sold in 3x3 sets.

rules.name: Uber organs
rules.note: Diablo's Horn, Baal's Eye, Mephisto's Brain (Uber Tristram).

rules.name: Colossal Ancient Statues
rules.note: RotW: 5 needed (one per act) to open the Colossal Summit; drop from terrorized act bosses in Hell. Drop rate nerfed in 3.3.

rules.name: Colossal Jewel upgrade materials
rules.note: RotW Uber Ancient upgrade materials (named Defender's Fire, Guardian's Light, ...).

rules.name: Worldstone Shards
rules.note: RotW Terror Zone drop; rate reduced in 3.3.

rules.name: Token of Absolution + essences
rules.note: Respec token and its essences.

rules.name: Perfect gems
rules.note: Sell in bulk (40 PGems), Perfect Amethyst needed for caster-amulet crafting.

rules.name: Magic grand charms
rules.note: Skillers (+1 skill tab) and 20+ life skillers are the value; most are trash. Unidentified only (magic charms drop unidentified); identified, the stat rules below decide.

rules.name: Magic small charms
rules.note: Valuable: 5 all res, 20 life, 7 MF, 3/20/20. Unidentified only (magic charms drop unidentified); identified, the stat rules below decide.

rules.name: Magic large charms
rules.note: Only 5-6 max dmg/20-35 life (sharp) sells. Unidentified only (magic charms drop unidentified); identified, the stat rules below decide.

rules.note: Fine of Vita: the top small charm (user list 2026-11-22).

rules.name: 5 all res, 20 life small charms

rules.name: 313+ poison small charms

rules.name: Max damage / AR / FHR small charms

rules.name: Max damage / AR / FRW small charms

rules.name: Max damage / AR / MF small charms

rules.name: 5 all res, MF small charms
rules.note: Shimmering with 7% MF.

rules.name: 5 all res, FHR small charms

rules.name: 5 all res, FRW small charms

rules.name: 100+ poison small charms

rules.name: High lightning damage small charms
rules.note: Shocking with Storms up to 2-99: rare.

rules.name: High fire damage small charms

rules.name: 6 MF small charms (own use)

rules.name: 14 all res grand charms

rules.name: 6/30/30 large charms
rules.note: Sharp of Vita: 6 max damage, 30-48 AR, 30-35 life.

rules.name: 8 all res, life large charms
rules.note: Shimmering 8 with 30-35 life. Every other large charm is vendor trash.

rules.name: Magic jewels
rules.label: MJ
rules.note: 40/15 IAS jewels, 30-40 ED (Fervor), 10-15 all res. Needs stats.

rules.name: Rare jewels
rules.label: RJ
rules.note: ED/IAS/res/-req rares can sell. Needs stats.

rules.name: Socketed magic circlets: +2 skills, 20 FCR or 30 FRW
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: a magic circlet with sockets, +2 class skills or +2 to a skill tree, plus 20 FCR or 30 FRW.

rules.name: Rare circlets: +2 skills, 20 FCR
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: +2 class skills or +2 to a skill tree, plus 20 FCR.

rules.name: Rare circlets: +2 skills, 2 sockets
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: +2 class skills or +2 to a skill tree, plus 2 sockets.

rules.name: Rare circlets: 20 FCR, 30 FRW
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: 20 FCR plus 30 FRW.

rules.name: Jeweler's Monarch (magic 4os)
rules.label: JMon
rules.note: A magic Monarch with 4 sockets is necessarily the Jeweler's prefix; "of Deflecting" suffix makes it very high.

rules.name: Jeweler's Archon Plate / Dusk Shroud (magic 4os)
rules.note: Value comes from the suffix (of the Whale 80-100 life).

rules.name: Rare caster rings: 10 FCR, two of str / dex / res / life / mana leech
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: 10 FCR plus two of 15 strength, 15 dexterity, 20 all res or 30 to one res, 30 life, 5 mana leech.

rules.name: Rare melee rings: life leech, AR, str or dex
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: 5 life leech plus 80 attack rating plus 15 strength or 15 dexterity.

rules.name: Rare amulets: +2 class skills, 10 FCR
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: +2 class skills plus 10 FCR.

rules.name: Rare amulets: +2 class skills, two of str / dex / res / life / mana leech
rules.note: User rule 2026-11-22: +2 class skills plus two of the caster ring stats (15 strength, 15 dexterity, 20 all res or 30 to one res, 30 life, 5 mana leech).

rules.name: Unidentified magic wands, scepters, orbs and daggers
rules.note: Every unidentified magic wand, scepter, sorceress orb and dagger: pick up and identify in town (user, 2026-11-22). Vendors pay well only for these (user, 2026-11-22: "the only ones that vendors in game buy a lot for is wands, scepters, and the sorc orbs and daggers (because of warlock)"). Only magic items roll +3 to a skill tab; once identified the +3 stat rules decide.

rules.name: +3 skill tab, 20 FCR caster items
rules.note: +3 to a class skill tab with 20% FCR (of the Magus) on wands, orbs and scepters: the top caster items.

rules.name: +3 skill tab wands, scepters, orbs and daggers
rules.note: +3 to a class skill tab (only magic items roll it) on the items vendors pay well for: wands, scepters, orbs, daggers (necromancer Poison and Bone and the three Warlock tabs).

rules.name: +2 skills, 20 FCR caster items
rules.note: +2 class skills with 20% FCR on wands, orbs, scepters (magic or rare).

rules.name: +2 skill tab, 20 FCR caster items
rules.note: +2 to a class skill tab with 20% FCR (rares top out at +2 tab).

rules.name: +3 money skill orbs
rules.note: +3 Fire Ball, Meteor, Lightning, Chain Lightning, Blizzard or Frozen Orb.

rules.name: +3 Bone Spear / Corpse Explosion wands
rules.note: +3 Bone Spear or Corpse Explosion.

rules.name: +3 Fist of the Heavens / Blessed Hammer scepters
rules.note: +3 Fist of the Heavens or Blessed Hammer.

rules.name: +3 skill white scepters
rules.note: White scepters roll up to three Paladin skills (+1..+3) innately; white items are identified, so the stats read on the ground. +3 to one sells. User 2026-11-22: white scepters with +3, no staves.

rules.name: Archon Plate / Dusk Shroud 3-4os
rules.note: 3os: Enigma (Jah Ith Ber). 4os: Chains of Honor / Fortitude. Superior (+def%) preferred.

rules.name: Other elite body armor 3-4os
rules.note: Enigma/CoH/Fortitude on Sacred Armor, Wyrmhide, Great Hauberk, Shadow/Lacquered/Hellforge/Balrog, Kraken. Superior preferred.

rules.name: Ethereal elite armor 4os (merc)
rules.note: Merc Fortitude / CoH; eth Sacred Armor (850+ def) is the best Fortitude merc base.

rules.name: Ethereal elite polearm/spear 4os
rules.note: Merc Infinity (Ber Mal Ber Ist) or Insight. Ethereal superior Thresher / Giant Thresher / Colossus Voulge / Cryptic Axe / Great Poleaxe / Mancatcher / Matriarchal Spear.

rules.name: Polearms 4os (any tier)
rules.note: Insight (Ral Tir Tal Sol) for the Act 2 merc. Normal-difficulty Voulge/Scythe/Poleaxe/Halberd/War Scythe already works; eth preferred but not required.

rules.name: Ethereal elite polearm/spear 5os
rules.note: Pride (Cham Sur Io Lo), Obedience (Hel Ko Thul Eth Fal), Doom on polearms.

rules.name: Phase Blade 5-6os
rules.note: 5os: Grief (Eth Tir Lo Mal Ral). 6os: Last Wish / BotD. Superior (ED) preferred; no durability so eth irrelevant.

rules.name: Berserker Axe / Colossus Blade / Thunder Maul / Archon Staff / War Pike / Hydra Bow 5-6os
rules.note: 5os: Death, Doom, Beast, Grief (axe). 6os: Breath of the Dying, Last Wish (axe/hammer). Ethereal superior strongly preferred (BotD/Death are indestructible).

rules.name: Swords 4os (Crystal/Dimensional/Phase/Long/Broad)
rules.note: Spirit sword (Tal Thul Ort Amn); 4os Crystal Sword drops in Normal (ilvl 26+). Also Hand of Justice / Phoenix on Phase Blade.

rules.name: Crystal Sword / Flail 5os
rules.note: Call to Arms (Amn Ral Mal Ist Ohm) swap weapon. Eth for style only.

rules.name: Flail/Knout/Scourge 4os
rules.note: Heart of the Oak (Ko Vex Pul Thul) swap/caster weapon.

rules.name: Monarch 4os
rules.note: Spirit shield (or Phoenix). Superior preferred.

rules.name: Paladin shields 4os (any tier)
rules.note: Spirit / Exile / Phoenix. Value is in the implicit res/ED roll (needs stats): superior 4os Sacred Targe/Rondache/Vortex with 40+ res = high. Normal-tier Targe/Rondache 4os = great twink Spirit.

rules.name: Ethereal paladin shields 4os
rules.note: Exile (Vex Ohm Ist Dol) self-repairs, so eth Sacred Targe/Vortex preferred.

rules.name: Grand Matron / Matriarchal Bow 4os
rules.note: Faith (Ohm Jah Lem Eld) for Act 2 merc / Rogue, Insight on bows.

rules.name: Amazon bows 5os
rules.note: Mist (Cham Shael Gul Thul Ith), Wrath/Ice-type builds.

rules.name: Bone Visage / Diadem / Tiara / Troll Nest 3os
rules.note: Dream (Io Jah Pul), Coven (Ist Ral Io, RotW), Flickering Flame, Metamorphosis. Best Dream bases are +skill Barb helms/Druid pelts (see class rule).

rules.name: Barbarian helms / Druid pelts 2-3os
rules.note: White class helms with +3 skills (e.g. +3 BO Barb helm, +3 Fury/Tornado pelt) for Dream/Lore/Metamorphosis/Coven. Implicit skills need stats.

rules.name: Mage Plate 3os
rules.note: Treachery, Duress, Smoke, Bone, Hustle, Authority (RotW). Eth for merc Treachery.

rules.name: Light body armor 2-3os (normal difficulty)
rules.note: 2os: Stealth (Tal Eth). 3os Ring Mail/Breast Plate: Smoke/Treachery/Authority twink.

rules.name: Kite / Large / Dragon shield 3os
rules.note: Ancient's Pledge (Ral Ort Tal) leveling shield.

rules.name: Helms 2os
rules.note: Lore (Ort Sol) leveling helm.

rules.name: Claws 3os
rules.note: Mosaic (Mal Gul Amn) / Plague. Best with +3 trap/martial arts implicits (needs stats).

rules.name: Phase Blade / Crystal Sword / Legend Sword 3os
rules.note: Lawbringer / Crescent Moon (merc). Cheap.

rules.name: Daggers 3os
rules.note: RotW Void (Thul Zod Ist) and Ritual (Amn Shael Ohm) for Warlock. Prefer Fanged Knife / Legend Spike; demand not settled.

rules.name: Grimoires 2os
rules.note: RotW Vigilance (Dol Gul) on Warlock books; also fits shields/heads.

rules.name: Low runes El-Fal
rules.note: Spirit (Tal Thul Ort Amn), Insight (Ral Tir Tal Sol), Stealth/Lore/Ancient's Pledge sets; Ko/Fal/Hel/Io/Lum feed mid runewords. Spirit and Insight rune sets trade.

rules.name: Sigon's Complete Steel
rules.label: Sigo
rules.note: Cheap full set for a twink (life leech, def, fire res; full set bonus). One of each piece is enough.
